title: Striver A2Z
description: Highly exhaustive DSA roadmap guiding you from complete basics up to advanced graph algorithms and heavy dynamic programming.

nodes.title: Basics & Sorting
nodes.description: Time/Space complexity, patterns, basic recursion, bubble/selection/insertion sort.
nodes.label: PHASE 1

nodes.title: Arrays & Binary Search
nodes.description: Subarrays, sliding window, searching in 1D and 2D arrays, boundary checks.
nodes.label: PHASE 2

nodes.title: Stack, Queue & Linked List
nodes.description: Implementations, DLL, circular lists, next greater element, LRU Cache.
nodes.label: PHASE 3

nodes.title: Greedy & Recursion
nodes.description: Huffman coding, fractional knapsack, N-queens, subset sums, sudoku solver.
nodes.label: PHASE 4

nodes.title: Trees & Graphs
nodes.description: Traversals, height, LCA, Dijkstra, Bellman Ford, MST, Disjoint Set.
nodes.label: PHASE 5

nodes.title: Dynamic Programming & Tries
nodes.description: Grid DP, MCM, digit DP, tree DP, trie insert/search.
nodes.label: FINALE
